liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Just A Little Light** (1 review): This performance is likely remembered as the final time the band played this song [19]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): The performance is described as very loose and especially out there [25]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Phil is playing as many notes as Jerry and is turned up in the mix [27]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): The reviewer considers this one of the more intense versions of the song they have heard [25]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Phil seems to be mischievously messing with the rest of the band during this song [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-07-21.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.95809.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 3.73/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd1990-07-21.150502.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 172 min [2]
- **gd1990-07-21.150562.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 167 min [4]
- **gd1990-07-21.143930.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 21 songs; 172 min [7]
- **gd90-07-21.sbd.conner.7832.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 159 min; rated 3.96/5 by 23 [11]. Said about its sound: The sound was described as weak compared to the previous Deer Creek shows; The recording is clumsy in parts, specifically the transition from Scarlet Begonias to Fire; Sound quality is pretty good and acceptable, though not stellar [20][22][23][30]

## Around the show

- Fifty kids climbed over the back fence during the first song, delighting the crowd [19]
- This was the first year for events at Tinley Park, a venue the reviewer disliked [20]
- The listener attended from the eleventh row, noting the people sitting next to them [21]
- Getting into the large venue was a nightmare, involving a single lane entry [22]
- A naked dancing woman covered in mud was hauled away from the crowd [26]
- A man wearing a warlock cloak and staff sat next to the reviewer [26]
- Kids were seen scamming into shows that would have been otherwise restricted [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-07-21.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.95809.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat Master (48k) [1]
- **gd1990-07-21.150502.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  August 11, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [2]
- **gd1990-07-21.150562.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) by KevinTobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [4]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user and converted to FLAC in September 2020 [4]
- **gd1990-07-21.143930.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Dave Brotman; transferred by Joe Noel and Charlie Miller; source: Dave Brotman Master DAT Recording: Schoeps CMC3 MK4 (ORTF) Oade PS > M100 cable > DAT (Panasonic SV250) [7]. Also: This file set is identified as the Master DAT, an upgrade to a previous upload [7]
- **gd90-07-21.sbd.conner.7832.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard DAT > CDR,EAC'ed / SHN'ed by Scott Clugston [11]
